license_required.quote: a person may not engage in the practice of optometry or purport in any way to be an optometrist or an expert in the field of optometry without having first obtained a license from the Oregon Board of Optometry

issuing_authority.quote: a license from the Oregon Board of Optometry as provided for in ORS 683.010 to 683.340

name.quote: a license from the Oregon Board of Optometry as provided for in ORS 683.010 to 683.340

type.quote: The Oregon Board of Optometry operates as a semi-independent state agency subject to ORS 182.456 to 182.472, for the purpose of carrying out this chapter.

degree_required.value: graduation from a school of optometry maintaining a standard of four school years of at least nine months each
degree_required.quote: graduation from a school of optometry that is approved by the Oregon Board of Optometry and that maintains a standard of four school years of at least nine months each

accrediting_body.quote: a school of optometry that is approved by the Oregon Board of Optometry

exams.name: Oregon Board of Optometry examination
exams.notes: Covers anatomy of the eye, pharmaceutical agents, refractive/accommodative/muscular conditions, subjective and objective optometry, lens fitting, and other subjects pertaining to optometry
exams.quote: The applicant shall be examined in the anatomy of the eye, in the use of pharmaceutical agents in optometry, in normal and abnormal refractive and accommodative and muscular conditions and coordination of the eye, in subjective and objective optometry

exams.name: National Board of Examiners in Optometry (NBEO)
exams.notes: Board may require NBEO certificate in lieu of its own examination in certain areas; also required for endorsement applicants
exams.quote: The board may, in its discretion, require the certificate of successful examination of the National Board of Examiners in Optometry in one or more areas of the examination in lieu of its examination in such areas.

exams.name: Oregon optometric law and administrative rules examination
exams.quote: Passes a written examination approved by the board on Oregon optometric law and administrative rules

required.quote: All optometrists licensed in the State of Oregon are and shall be required to satisfactorily complete courses of study and satisfactorily continue their education by other means as determined by the Oregon Board of Optometry

period_years.quote: shall be submitted by each optometrist at the time designated by the board but in any case no less frequently than once every two years

available.quote: The Oregon Board of Optometry may grant to an applicant a license by endorsement for the practice of optometry in the State of Oregon if the applicant

requirements.value: Holds a license obtained by examination in another state; continuously practiced optometry for at least 2 years; equivalent educational qualifications including NBEO; meets Therapeutic Pharmaceutical Agent certification requirements; passes Oregon law exam; submits equivalent CE hours; pays application fee
requirements.quote: Holds a license for the practice of optometry obtained by examination in another state of the United States. Any discipline or sanction related to the practice of optometry imposed upon the applicant by any state licensing agency must be disclosed on the application for licensure

regulatory_model.quote: a person may not engage in the practice of optometry or purport in any way to be an optometrist or an expert in the field of optometry without having first obtained a license from the Oregon Board of Optometry

credential_type.quote: Each applicant, without discrimination, who meets the requirements for examination and licensure and who pays the fee shall be issued a certificate of licensure.

is_mandatory.quote: a person may not engage in the practice of optometry or purport in any way to be an optometrist or an expert in the field of optometry without having first obtained a license from the Oregon Board of Optometry

title_protection.quote: Advertise or represent, by displaying a sign or otherwise, to be an optometrist without having at the time of so doing a valid unrevoked license from the board.

scope_protection.quote: Practice optometry in this state without having at the time of so doing a valid unrevoked license as an optometrist.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or misdemeanor bearing a demonstrable relationship to the duties of an optometrist
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony or misdemeanor where such an offense bears a demonstrable relationship to the duties of an optometrist.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Securing a license by practicing fraud or deceit upon the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Securing a license by practicing fraud or deceit upon the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unprofessional conduct, or gross ignorance or inefficiency in the profession
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unprofessional conduct, or for gross ignorance or inefficiency in the profession.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining any fee by fraud or misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining any fee by fraud or misrepresentation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing directly or indirectly any suspended or unlicensed optometrist to perform covered work
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employing directly or indirectly any suspended or unlicensed optometrist to perform any work covered by ORS 683.010 to 683.340.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising optometric services using untruthful, improbable, misleading or deceitful statements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising optometric services or treatment or advice in which untruthful, improbable, misleading or deceitful statements are made.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting another person to use the optometrist's license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Permitting another person to use the optometrist's license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising without indicating a licensed optometrist is practicing at the advertised location
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using advertisements that do not indicate that a licensed optometrist is practicing at the advertised location or locations or advertising optometric services without having a licensed optometrist at the location or locations.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising professional methods or professional superiority
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising professional methods or professional superiority.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with the requirements for continuing education
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to comply with the requirements for continuing education.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating the federal Controlled Substances Act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating the federal Controlled Substances Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing controlled substances without a legitimate optometric purpose or without following accepted procedures
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing controlled substances without a legitimate optometric purpose, or without following accepted procedures for examination of patients or for record keeping.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report adverse actions taken against the optometrist by another licensing jurisdiction or health regulatory body
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to report to the board any adverse action taken against the optometrist or person by another licensing jurisdiction, health regulatory board, peer review body, health care institution, professional optometric society or association, governmental agency, law enforcement agency or court

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having been disciplined by a health regulatory board of another state for similar acts
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having been disciplined by any health regulatory board of another state based on acts similar to acts described in this section.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any violation of the provisions of ORS 683.010 to 683.340
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any violation of the provisions of ORS 683.010 to 683.340.

oral_pharmaceutical_authority.quote: "Optometric nontopical formulary" means the list of nontopical pharmaceutical agents for the treatment of diseases of the human eye and the protocols for their usage adopted by the Council on Optometric Nontopical Formulary

pharmaceutical_certification_required.quote: Every person desiring to commence the practice of optometry or employ the use of pharmaceutical agents shall in addition to the requirements of subsection (1) of this section: (a) Have satisfactorily completed a course in pharmacology, as it applies to optometry

specialty_certification_types.quote: Meets the requirements for Therapeutic Pharmaceutical Agent certification established by rule by the board

supervised_clinical_internship_required.quote: Demonstrate to the satisfaction of the board clinical competency in the prescription of pharmaceutical agents listed on the optometric nontopical formulary.

comanagement_with_ophthalmologist_requir.quote: An optometrist treating a patient with antiglaucoma medication shall consult with an ophthalmologist if: (A) The glaucoma progresses despite the use of two glaucoma medications; (B) More than two medications are required to control the glaucoma; or (C) A secondary glaucoma develops.

delegation_to_unlicensed_assistants_auth.quote: To prohibit vision or eye care practices by persons working under the direct supervision of an optometrist authorized to practice in this state

telemedicine_authorized.quote: A licensed optometrist may engage in the practice of telemedicine

spectacle_prescription_release_required.quote: Immediately upon completion of the necessary visual examination or examinations performed by a licensed optometrist, the optometrist shall provide the patient with the appropriate written prescription for correcting refractive errors, if any, in the eyesight of the patient.

limited_teaching_license_available.quote: Any optometrist licensed in another state, while a professor or instructor in such a college, may sign optometric prescriptions on behalf of the clinic, but not otherwise.

retired_license_status_available.quote: Each optometrist who is retired, has a disability or is a nonresident of the State of Oregon and who is not practicing optometry within this state shall on the date established by the board pay a license fee
